remarks: Welcome to 23 Mead St in sought-after Mead Common; this residence epitomizes modern luxury condo living. This exceptional home offers a private pathway leading directly from Mead St to your front door and into expansive, sun-drenched interiors with soaring nine foot ceilings and tons of windows. Enjoy the convenience of your own attached two-car garage, with built-in shelves and storage closet, a new water heater and an elevator that connects all three levels, including a finished lower level providing great space for a home office or a cozy den, plus laundry and a half bath. The main floor features an open-concept design, seamlessly integrating living, dining, and kitchen areas, complete with a wood-burning fireplace and access to an oversized, south-facing private bluestone terrace-ideal for entertaining or simply basking in the sun. The second floor boasts a generous primary suite with vaulted ceilings, ensuite bath and a spacious walk-in closet, two additional bedrooms and a second full bath. Located just a short walk from the village, train station and New Canaan's world class library, Mead Common offers the perfect blend of comfort and accessibility. Experience this rare chance of the best of New Canaan living at Mead Common!
